verdict.rationale: Docs say tools can call any service with an API, including Stripe and your own internal endpoints. They cite a refund tool directly, and each tool can be gated behind Slack human approval with conditions such as amounts above $100, or set to auto-approve per task. That gives per-action authorization control over real API actions, though all evidence is vendor-claimed. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-action credential/OAuth scoping (beyond approval gating and general role-based access), order-change and subscription-update examples, and independent hands-on corroboration.
